note: Triennial election of the Cookstown rural district councillors, 1939. Nominations were received on Tuesday 18 April 1939 by Mr. James M'Cammon, clerk, as deputy returning officer. 'There will be no contests for any of the seats on the new Cookstown Rural Council ... All the candidates are returned unopposed' (Mid-Ulster Mail, 22 April 1939, p. 9). Sixteen divisions are recorded. No nomination was received for Beaghmore, 'at present represented by Mr. James Loughran. In all probability he will again take his seat'; as its retiring member he was deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed. No poll was held; the folder date is the provisional Tyrone polling day. No nomination was received; the paper names the member as Mr. James Loughran. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
